description: Fetch a capture by id: status, ask, share_url, and the frames captured so far. Each frame has desktop_url/mobile_url (authenticated JPEG endpoints), `picked_why` (why the page was picked, when site+ask mode chose it) and an optional `failure` word: 'challenge' (the site demanded a human check), 'blank' (the page never rendered), 'sparse' (the site withheld its content), or 'http_<status>'. A page that produced nothing is absent, never faked.

id.description: The capture id returned by the capture tool.

name: get_capture
title: Get a capture's status and frames
